description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing and retrieving employee performance tracker's data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing multiple trackers, retrieving a specific tracker by ID, and placeholder methods for create, update, and delete operations which are not implemented. The class uses traits and dependencies to handle authorization, validation, and data access, and integrates Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
